commands.description: Runs a command script containing console commands.
shutdown the server.
show server information (version and startup path).  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
show server startup time and uptime.  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
show server version.  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
synonym for quit
In OpenSimulator 0.7.5 and later, print the current console logging level.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.4 and earlier please use the "set log level" command instead without a level parameter.

change the console logging level only. For example, off or debug. See Logging for more information.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.4 and earlier, if called without the level argument prints the current level.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.5 and later please use the "get log level" command instead.  Only available on ROBUST console from OpenSimulator 0.7.5.
Runs a command script containing console commands.
shutdown the server.
show server information (version and startup path).  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
show server startup time and uptime.  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
show server version.  Before OpenSimulator 0.7.5 this is only available on the simulator console.
synonym for quit
In OpenSimulator 0.7.5 and later, print the current console logging level.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.4 and earlier please use the "set log level" command instead without a level parameter.

change the console logging level only. For example, off or debug. See Logging for more information.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.4 and earlier, if called without the level argument prints the current level.  In OpenSimulator 0.7.5 and later please use the "get log level" command instead.  Only available on ROBUST console from OpenSimulator 0.7.5.

Turn on/off extra logging for HTTP request debugging.  Only available on robust console from commit 94517c8 (dev code post 0.7.3.1).  In current development code (for OpenSimulator 0.7.5) this is debug http in|out|all [<level>] since outbound HTTP messages can also now be logged (this was only possible for inbound before). For more information on this command, see Debugging.
subsequent commands apply only to the specified region. If region name is "root" then all regions are selected
Turn on packet debugging, where OpenSimulator prints out summaries of incoming and outgoing packets for viewers, depending on the level set
turn emergency debugging monitoring mode on or off.
Get general command list or more detailed help on a specific command or set of commands
Set a local grid co-ordinate to link to a remote hypergrid
Link a HyperGrid region. Not sure how this differs from link-mapping
List modules
Load a module
Unload a module
Returns a variety of statistics about the current region and/or simulator

Sets the terrain texture heights on corner #<corner> to <min>/<max>, if <x> or <y> are specified, it will only set it on regions with a matching coordinate. Specify -1 in <x> or <y> to wildcard that coordinate. Corner # SW = 0, NW = 1, SE = 2, NE = 3.
Sets the terrain <number> to <uuid>, if <x> or <y> are specified, it will only set it on regions with a matching coordinate. Specify -1 in <x> or <y> to wildcard that coordinate.
show all registered capabilities URLs
subsequent commands apply only to the specified region. If region name is "root" then all regions are selected
Turn on packet debugging, where OpenSimulator prints out summaries of incoming and outgoing packets for viewers, depending on the level set
turn emergency debugging monitoring mode on or off.
Get general command list or more detailed help on a specific command or set of commands
Set a local grid co-ordinate to link to a remote hypergrid
Link a HyperGrid region. Not sure how this differs from link-mapping
List modules
Load a module
Unload a module
Returns a variety of statistics about the current region and/or simulator

Sets the terrain texture heights on corner #<corner> to <min>/<max>, if <x> or <y> are specified, it will only set it on regions with a matching coordinate. Specify -1 in <x> or <y> to wildcard that coordinate. Corner # SW = 0, NW = 1, SE = 2, NE = 3.
Sets the terrain <number> to <uuid>, if <x> or <y> are specified, it will only set it on regions with a matching coordinate. Specify -1 in <x> or <y> to wildcard that coordinate.
show all registered capabilities URLs
Find out which avatar uses the given asset as a baked texture, if any.
Send a request to the user's viewer for it to rebake and reupload its appearance textures.
Send appearance data for each avatar in the simulator to other viewers.
Show appearance information for avatars.
Load user inventory archive. See Inventory Archives.
load an OpenSimulator archive. This entirely replaces the current region. Default filename is region.oar. See OpenSim Archives.
Load a region's data from XML format (0.7.*: DEPRECATED and may be REMOVED soon. Use "load xml2" instead)
Attempt a deep scan and cache of all assets in all scenes
Remove all assets in the cache.  If file or memory is specified then only this cache is cleared.
Purge cached assets older then the specified date/time
Display cache status
Do JPEG2000 decoding of an asset.
Get the current configuration, either for a particular key, a particular section or the whole config.
Save the current configuration to a file.
Set a particular configuration value. On the whole, this is useless since neither OpenSimulator nor modules dynamically reload config values.
Synonym for 'config get'
Shows all parcels on the current region.
Clears all parcels on the land.
Save an image of the world map (default name is exportmap.jpg)
Regenerates and stores map tile.  Only in development code post 0.7.6.

Persist currently unsaved object changes immediately instead of waiting for the normal persistence call.  This shouldn't normally be required - the simulator persists region objects automatically at regular intervals and on shutdown.
Delete a scene object by creator
Delete a scene object by name.

Delete all scene objects outside region boundaries.  This is currently if z < 0 or z > 10000.  Object outside these bounds have been known to cause issues with OpenSimulator's use of some physics engines (such as the Open Dynamics Engine).
Delete a scene object by owner
Delete a scene object by uuid or localID. Pre 0.7.5, this was "delete object uuid".
Dump the serialization of the given object to a file for debug purposes.
Change the scale of a named prim
Force the region to send all clients updates about all objects.
Show details of scene objects with the given name.
Show details of a scene object with the given UUID or localID. Pre 0.7.5, this was "show object uuid".
Show details of scene object parts with the given name.
Show details of a scene object parts with the given UUID or localID. Pre 0.7.5, this was "show part uuid".
reload estate data
Attaches the specified region to the specified estate.
This command will show the estate name, ID, and owner for regions currently running in the simulator. This list does not necessarily include all estates that are present in the database.
subsequent commands apply only to the specified region. If region name is "root" then all regions are selected
Create a new region
Delete a region from disk.
Post OpenSimulator 0.8.0.*.  Show region parameters (Region Name, Region UUID, Location, URI, Owner ID, Flags).
Abort a scheduled region restart, with an optional message

Schedule a region restart. If one delta is given then the region is restarted in delta seconds time. A time to restart is sent to users in the region as a dismissable bluebox notice. If multiple deltas are given then a notice is sent when we reach each delta.
Schedule a region restart. Same as above except showing a transient notice instead of a dismissable bluebox.

Post OpenSimulator 0.8.0.*.  Set certain region parameters.  Currently, can set
 agent-limit - The current avatar limit for the region.  More usually this is set via the region/estate dialog in a typical viewer.  This persists over simulator restarts.
 max-agent-limit - The maximum value that agent-limit can have.  Unfortunately, setting it here does not currently persist over server restarts.  For that to happen it must be separately set as the MaxAgents parameter in the region config file.
The current avatar limit for the region.  More usually this is set via the region/estate dialog in a typical viewer.  This persists over simulator restarts.

The maximum value that agent-limit can have.  Unfortunately, setting it here does not currently persist over server restarts.  For that to happen it must be separately set as the MaxAgents parameter in the region config file.
remove a region from the simulator
Restarts all sims in this instance
Restarts just one sim in an instance. Set the console to the region name first, with 'change region <regionname>', or all regions will restart.
Set database flags for region
Turn on scene debugging
Rotates scene around 128,128 axis by x degrees where x=0-360.
Scales all scene objects by a factor where original size =1.0.
Translate (move) the entire scene to a new coordinate. Useful for moving a scene to a different location on either a Mega or Variable region.
Resumes all suspended scripts
Show script information. <script-item-uuid> option only exists from git master 82f0e19 (2012-01-14) onwards (post OpenSimulator 0.7.2).
Starts all stopped scripts
Stops all running scripts
Suspends all running scripts
show useful statistical information for this server. See Frame Statistics Values below for more information.
a synonym for "show stats" (OpenSimulator dev code only post 19th March 2014).
record stats periodically to a separate log file.
save a snapshot of current stats to a file (OpenSimulator dev code only post 19th March 2014).
Loads a terrain from a specified file. (see note1)
Loads a terrain from a section of a larger file.
Saves the current heightmap to a specified file.
Saves the current heightmap to the larger file.
Fills the current heightmap with a specified value.
Raises the current heightmap by the specified amount.
Lowers the current heightmap by the specified amount.
Multiplies the heightmap by the value specified.
Saves the current terrain into the regions baked map.
Loads the baked map terrain into the regions heightmap.
Enables experimental brushes which replace the standard terrain brushes.
Shows terrain height at a given co-ordinate.
Shows some information about the regions heightmap for debugging purposes.
Runs a specified plugin effect
Flips the current terrain about the X or Y axis
Rescales the current terrain to fit between the given min and max heights
Sets the minimum terrain height to the specified value.
Sets the maximum terrain height to the specified value.
Provides several area-of-effect terraforming commands.
Change activity state for the trees module
Freeze/Unfreeze activity for a defined copse
Load a copse definition from an xml file
Start the planting on a copse
Reset the tree update rate (mSec)
Reload copse definitions from the in-scene trees
Remove a copse definition and all its in-scene trees
Log statistics about the trees
send an in-world alert to everyone
send an an in-world alert to a specific user
Bypass in-world permission checks
Turn on permissions debugging
Force permissions on or off.
Kick a user off the simulator
Disable user entry to this simulator
Enable user entry to this simulator
Show whether logins to this simulator are enabled or disabled

commands.command: show users [full]- show info about currently connected users to this region. Without the 'full' option, only users actually on the region are shown. With the 'full' option child agents of users in neighbouring regions are also shown.
